svg.aria-label: A compares teaching models of a uniform sphere and ideal Gaussian chain at the same Rg, using dimensionless axes. B shows actual high-q SASDAC2 observations on a linear scale, retaining negative values. The panels distinguish shape information from weak-signal quality.
